name: marketplace-api-contract
description: Homework 09: OpenAPI contract for the Marketplace API + runtime validation at the boundary (option B), on NestJS

scripts.db:schema: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f - < db/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f - < db/seed.sql
scripts.db:indexes: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f - < db/indexes.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U marketplace -d marketplace -q -c "ANALYZE;"
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U marketplace -d marketplace
